messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Semiconductor?

The passages do not rank “most important” capabilities specifically for Semiconductor, but they do identify chip-vendor / chipset validation goals and the signaling, protocol, RF, application, automation, and conformance capabilities that apply to that value-chain role [12][54][58].
| Signaling test capability | What the passages support for Semiconductor / chipset-related applications |
|---|---|
| Chipset L1–L4 verification and modem-stack debug | Validation and conformance goals include chipset L1–L4 test plan and verification, investigating and debugging the modem stack, and assuring robustness / reliability and performance on L1–L3 [12]. |
| Cellular signaling coverage across LTE and 5G NR | R&S CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing, covering LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [6]. |
| Protocol and signaling test coverage | The 5G device testing value chain lists Signaling Protocol among test types, and maps signaling / protocol / application tools to R&S CMX500, R&S CMW500, and R&S CMsquares [54][57]. |
| RF measurements under signaling | Supported signaling test RF measurements include Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER, and MIMO [94]. |
| Receiver, throughput, and link-performance testing | CMX500 features include Fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, Throughput measurement, and PER measurement [6]. |
| Pre-conformance / design-verification testing | 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing is positioned for early product development and design verification, using selected 3GPP TS 38.521-1 NR-FR1 SA test cases on CMX500 [90]. |
| RF pre-conformance test groups | Covered RF pre-conformance groups include UE output power, power dynamics / tolerance, modulation quality, spectrum, and receiver / throughput tests [91]. |
| End-to-end application and IP-stack validation | Validation goals include optimizing IMS / SIP / TCP/IP end-to-end performance and investigating / debugging the app stack; CMX500 application features include application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS / audio / POLQA [12][6]. |
| WLAN / Wi-Fi signaling and coexistence testing | CMX500 provides WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, and 2x2 MIMO [6]. |
| Wi-Fi 7 real-world signaling tests | Wi-Fi 7 R&D testing requires signaling mode and real-world-condition RF TX / RX measurements, and listed Wi-Fi 7-specific tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities [13]. |
| Multi-technology desense / interference testing | WLAN + cellular in one box enables interference / desense testing against LTE / NR bands with real connections, including EN-DC + WiFi7 and LTE + NR + WiFi measurements in parallel [20]. |
| Mobility, services, and user-experience application tests | Callbox application / mobility use cases include Mobility Testing, Network Slicing, IP Throughput, Security Analysis, IMS Services, WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN, ATSSS, Power Consumption, XR Responsiveness & L4S, eCall / NGeCall, and Speech Quality [53]. |
| Automation, scripting, and reporting | CMX500 interfaces include CMsquares GUI, CMXmars message log analysis, CMsequencer graphical scripting, XLAPI Python scripting, and SCPI remote control [4]. |
| Automated pre-conformance execution | CMsequencer 3GPP 5G SA pre-conformance provides automated execution, validation, and comprehensive reporting under the CMX-KC661B license [35]. |
| Manufacturing-adjacent debug and RF optimization | Manufacturing goals include high device yield, shortest possible test time, RF transceiver subsystem characterization / optimization, and debug / trace [10]. |

- Single cell per SIM：SIM1 連 cell A，SIM2 連 cell B，兩邊 data transmission。
- Paging：Page SIM1 on NR cell A、Page SIM2 on NR cell B，並兩邊 data transmission。
- Handover：SIM1 handover to cell C，SIM2 handover to cell D。
- Suspend / Resume：SIM1 / SIM2 suspend and resume；procedures could overlap。
- CA：兩個 SIM 各自配置 PCell / SCells，並同時 data transmission。
- NR-DC：兩個 SIM 各自配置 PCell / PSCell，並同時 data transmission；來源註明 low prio based on customer feedback。

CMX500 Multi-SIM testing › DSDA
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，[[DSDA]]（dual SIM dual active）：

- Two TRX。
- 2 SIMs in active connection at a time。

依 [[Dual Sim Dual Active]]，Release 18 DSDA 的 3GPP / stack 背景是：

- dual-Tx / dual-Rx MUSIM UE 可同時維持兩個 [[RRC_CONNECTED]] states。
- UE 可能先連到一個 network，再連到第二個 network。
- UE 可將部分 hardware capabilities 移給第二個 network。
- hardware capability sharing 與 band conflict 可能導致 temporary capability restriction。
- Network A 是 NR，Network B 可以是 E-UTRA 或 NR。

⚠️ [[Dual Sim Dual Active]]（2026-09-24 converted；來源未標示正式日期）說 DSDA 表格列為 answering new call 時 ongoing call is released、DR-DA 才是 ongoing call is kept，但既有頁面 [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]] 說 example use case 中 call on SIM1 on hold 並可回到 SIM1。判斷：可能是 DSDA / DR-DA terminology、call service handling 與 CMX500 demo slide 的層級差異；未回查原 PDF / release note 前不裁決。
